OPTION_A_longitudinal_capability.scientific_question: Can the framework track validated body-link changes as Gaga practice accumulates?
OPTION_A_longitudinal_capability.committee_understands_in_3_seconds: Validated link changes appear at ~4 classes and again at ~10 classes, differently across people; coverage is not equal.
OPTION_A_longitudinal_capability.exact_data_used: File 03 A2 flags for D12 and D13; coverage bands; optional persistence labels
OPTION_A_longitudinal_capability.visual_form: Per participant: two compact body-link glyphs / evidence rings (≈4 classes | ≈10 classes). Highlight = beyond own repetition variability AND directionally stable. Explicit coverage markers. No trajectory connecting counts as learning magnitude.
OPTION_A_longitudinal_capability.main_risk: Uneven T3 coverage; link-count misread as amount of learning; partial adjacency to G4 anatomy
OPTION_A_longitudinal_capability.duplicates_G2_or_G4: Distinct from G2. Adjacent to G4 but asks longitudinal capability across exposures rather than detailed anatomical localization.

OPTION_B_repetition_analytical_robustnes.scientific_question: Does the JcvPCA contribution pattern remain similar for pooled R1+R2, R1-only, and R2-only, and under PC-count / QC variants?
OPTION_B_repetition_analytical_robustnes.committee_understands_in_3_seconds: The analysis was stress-tested across repetition designs and analytical variants; stability varies by participant.
OPTION_B_repetition_analytical_robustnes.exact_data_used: File 06 comparison-level overlaps + k-grid + qc_drop + functional bands; link-level pooled/R1/R2 signed values
OPTION_B_repetition_analytical_robustnes.visual_form: Per participant×comparison: Pooled ↔ R1 ↔ R2 overlap representation; restrained k-grid sparkline; authoritative overall label only
OPTION_B_repetition_analytical_robustnes.main_risk: Technical/dashboard-like; top-5 overlap is a coarse stability proxy

OPTION_C_dual_exposure_status_without_co.scientific_question: Which validated links appear early, later, both, or neither — without ranking participants by count?
OPTION_C_dual_exposure_status_without_co.committee_understands_in_3_seconds: Some validated changes persist across exposures; others appear only early or only later.
OPTION_C_dual_exposure_status_without_co.visual_form: Categorical link status chips (early / later / both / neither) + coverage badges
OPTION_C_dual_exposure_status_without_co.main_risk: Denser than Option A; still needs anti-learning caption
OPTION_C_dual_exposure_status_without_co.duplicates_G2_or_G4: Less anatomical than G4; more longitudinal than G2
